basis: 300 bar differential, 110 cc/rev, motor torque efficiency0.90, spur efficiency0.97, bevel efficiency0.97. These are screening assumptions, not pressure settings or efficiency maps.
shaft_rating_caveat: TCS is a functional limit, TDW reversing-fatigue value. Neither substitutes for an angle, speed and life calculation. Shock case is not a continuous fatigue capacity.
bevel_screen_caveat: Illustrative Lewis factor0.30 with cone correction; no allowable stress chosen. No ISO/AGMA contact, bending, scuffing or duty-cycle rating completed.
articulation_scope: Shaft length uses joint-centre spacing, not flange spacing. Parallel axes and no wheelset pitch/yaw assumed. Actual suspension constraints and joint positions need confirmation.
clearance_scope: Only nominal and simple bounding-plane checks. No full swept solid, hose bend, yaw, brake, service-access or route clearance acceptance.
geometry_limits: Bevel teeth are tapered illustrations, not conjugate tooth forms.
Spur teeth are a coarse involute approximation, no fillets/backlash.
Commercial motor/joints/bearings are interface or boundary models, not complete supplier CAD.
Housings lack finished split joints, lubrication, shoulders and complete seal/bolt/retainer detailing.
Wheel tread/flange, press fits, axle fatigue, axleboxes, suspension, brakes and guards not complete.
